prompt_text: I need a dental implant in Houston. Which specific dental practices should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Houston for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — but first a quick question so I give useful, specific names: what part of Houston (zip code or neighborhood) are you in or near? Also tell me if you prefer an oral surgeon, periodontist or a one-stop implant center that does both the surgery and the final crown/bridge, and whether insurance/price or same‑day/full‑arch options matter to you.

While you reply, here’s a short plan plus what I’ll look for when I pick specific practices for you:

What I’ll use to choose and why it matters
- Board credentials and specialty: board‑certified oral & maxillofacial surgeons (ABOMS) or periodontists (AAP) have advanced surgical training and are ideal for placing implants in complex cases. Prosthodontists are best for complex restorative work.
- CBCT (3D) imaging availability: essential for safe, precise implant planning.
- Experience/volume: practices that place many implants tend to have lower complication rates and more predictable results.
- Restorative capability or team approach: you want the surgeon and the restorative dentist (prosthodontist or general dentist) to coordinate the final crown/bridge.
- Financing/warranty and clear fee breakdown: implants can vary widely in cost — you should get an itemized plan.
- Patient reviews and before/after photos: help assess outcomes and patient satisfaction.
- Sedation options and facility standards: if you want IV sedation or general anesthesia, pick an office with proper monitoring and credentialing.

Questions to ask when you call
- Are implants placed and restored here, or do you refer the restoration elsewhere?
- Do you use CBCT 3D imaging for planning?
- How many implants do you place per month? (volume/experience)
- Are you board‑certified? Which specialists will be involved?
- Can I see before/after photos of similar cases and patient references?
- What is the full estimated cost (implant + abutment + crown; any grafting)?
- What anesthesia/sedation options do you offer and what are the credentials of the person administering it?
- Do you offer any financing or payment plans and a warranty on the implant/restoration?

If you tell me your neighborhood/zip and preferences, I’ll return a curated list of 4–6 specific Houston practices (with reasons why to call each) and suggest the one likely best for your needs.
